title: Deal rooms
description: Mutual action plans on your deals. Open a room on a deal from a template: milestones and steps with dates counted back from the close date, an owner on each side, shared content and a conversation, with internal notes kept to your team.

daysBeforeClose.label: Days before close
daysBeforeClose.help: When it is due, counted back from the deal's close date. Negative is after the close.

ownerRole.label: Owner role
ownerRole.help: A seller team role (Account executive) or a stakeholder's role in the deal (champion, executive, procurement).

stakeholders.label: Stakeholders
stakeholders.help: The buyer's people on this deal. A step whose owner role matches one's role in the deal is theirs.

templates.delete.label: Delete template
templates.delete.reason: deleting a template deletes its steps; rooms made from it keep theirs

guards.message: Each member is on the team once.

rooms.delete.label: Delete room
rooms.delete.reason: deleting a room deletes its plan, content and comments

guards.message: Name an owner on our side or the buyer's.

steps.attach.label: Attach file
steps.attach.reason: a file is uploaded by a person

steps.delete.label: Delete step
steps.delete.reason: deleting a step removes it from the plan

assets.share.label: Share with buyer
assets.share.reason: sharing shows workspace content to the buyer

comments.post.label: Post
comments.post.reason: a comment the buyer reads is a person's

guards.message: Write a comment of up to 2,000 characters.

steps.buyerAttach.label: Attach file

archive.label: Archive

buyerDone.label: Mark done
buyerDone.reason: A buyer completes their step in their own browser.

buyerReopen.label: Reopen my completed step

seedTemplates.reason: templates are the team's to choose

stakeholders.help: The buyer's people you know of. Steps go to whoever holds their role in the deal; the rest wait for an owner.
